bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears defeated the New England Patriots 30-24 on Thursday Night Football, improving to 5-2 as Caleb Williams and the Chicago Bears outdueled Drake Maye and the New England Patriots in a battle of young star quarterbacks . The win was overshadowed by injury concerns after Bears tight end Cole Kmet was believed to have suffered a season-ending knee injury during the game.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions made roster moves ahead of their Week 7 matchup against the Green Bay Packers, adding returner DeAndre Carter to the active roster and signing safety Myles Bryant to the practice squad . The team also got encouraging injury news as defensive back Brian Branch said he is "ready to roll" and nears his 2026 season debut, stating he wants to "just let the plays come to me and not force anything."

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The biggest story centers on Green Bay's Week 7 matchup against the Detroit Lions, with head coach Matt LaFleur downplaying injury concerns as he doesn't seem to be too concerned about the status of his team's top two weapons downfield heading into Sunday's game at Ford Field against the Detroit Lions . Meanwhile, the Packers' defense has drawn attention for its disruptive scheme, as Gannon's creative blitz looks are making it very hard for opposing offensive lines to identify who's rushing, leading to plenty of pressure on opposing quarterbacks , setting up a pivotal divisional showdown this Sunday.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings (5-0) are getting healthier ahead of Sunday's home game against the Indianapolis Colts, with receiver Justin Jefferson, right tackle Brian O'Neill, and cornerback James Pierre all upgraded to full participants on Thursday , while starting left guard Donovan Jackson was ruled out with a knee injury . Separately, defensive coordinator Brian Flores addressed renewed attention on his ongoing legal fight, as he is keeping his focus on football despite renewed scrutiny surrounding his racial discrimination lawsuit against the NFL .
